title: The Bank of Canada aims at the 2 percent midpoint of a 1 to 3 percent CPI range
summary: The Bank of Canada aims at the 2 percent midpoint of a 1 to 3 percent CPI range.
body: The Bank of Canada says it aims to keep inflation at the 2 percent midpoint of a target range of 1 to 3 percent, expressed as the year-over-year increase in the total consumer price index. The source says: "Measures of inflation The Bank of Canada aims to keep inflation at the 2 per cent midpoint of an inflation-control target range of 1 to 3 per cent." The operational target is a midpoint inside a range, on the CPI. It is not the ECB's HICP target and not the Fed's PCE target.
